notes: Widget Customizer & Live Settings Preview (v2.0.3): Added Settings > Widgets > Customize widget (also reachable via widget long-press) with live 2:1 preview in Settings and Customizer, Same/Different Photo Picker (zero storage permission) + Album Art & Swap, 9 Frame styles (None, Rounded, Circle, Polaroid, Neon, Gradient ring, Film, Stamp, Vinyl) with 6 accent colors, corner radius, border width & in-app Float/Spin/Pulse motion, 5 Backgrounds (Photo, Aurora, Sunset, Ocean, Solid) with Blur (0-60), Darkness (0-100%) & contrast warning, fixed 2:1 Background Cropper (800x400 JPEG), Small/Wide/Large prebuilt Canvas bitmaps, clean title+artist view for songs without lyrics, and Developer Mode JSON export + bitmap rebuild timer

Lyrics Animation Picker & 5 Transition Styles (v2.0.1): Settings > Lyrics > Lyrics animation sheet with 5 looping live-preview cards (Slide Up, Blur Fade, Karaoke Fill, Typewriter, Pop Zoom), Both/App/Widget targeting, and zero-polling LRC widget transitions
